description:
Address test execution gaps and coverage enforcement. Analysis (Dec 2025) found:
- 7,876 total tests (7,318 unit + 558 integration)
- Platform adapter test coverage: 94% (17/18 adapters have tests)
- CRITICAL: 90.5% of unit test files lack @pytest.mark markers
- CI only runs tests marked "fast", causing unmarked tests to be skipped
- This gap caused the PYSPARK_AVAILABLE NameError bug (commit 9d524094)
